seoTitle: Integrate Shiprocket Checkout with Shopify (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Learn how to connect Shiprocket checkout to your Shopify store, configure shipping rates for India, and sync orders automatically to cut cart abandonment.
intro: If you run a Shopify store in India and want a faster, more reliable checkout, connecting Shiprocket can streamline both your fulfillment and shipping process. This guide walks through installing the Shiprocket app, configuring the checkout API, and syncing orders so your delivery workflow runs on autopilot. By the end you'll have a tested checkout flow ready for real customers.

steps.heading: Install the Shiprocket app on Shopify
steps.body: Head to the Shopify App Store, search for Shiprocket, and add it to your store. This connects your Shopify account to Shiprocket's fulfillment network.

steps.heading: Set up the checkout API and configuration
steps.body: Inside the app, configure the Shiprocket checkout API so orders placed on your store pass shipping details directly to Shiprocket for processing.

steps.heading: Configure shipping rates and delivery zones
steps.body: Set up shipping rates and delivery zones tailored to India so customers see accurate costs and delivery estimates at checkout.

steps.heading: Sync orders automatically
steps.body: Enable order syncing between Shopify and the Shiprocket dashboard so every new order shows up automatically without manual entry.

steps.heading: Test the checkout flow
steps.body: Place a test order to confirm shipping rates, order sync, and checkout experience all work smoothly before going live.

faq.question: Do I need a Shiprocket account before integrating with Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll need an active Shiprocket account to connect the app and access the checkout API and dashboard features.

faq.question: Will this integration slow down my checkout?
faq.answer: A properly configured integration is designed to speed up checkout by streamlining shipping calculations, not add delays.

faq.question: Can I customize shipping rates by region?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure shipping rates and delivery zones specifically for different areas within India.

faq.question: How do I know if orders are syncing correctly?
faq.answer: Check your Shiprocket dashboard after placing a test order on Shopify; it should appear automatically if the sync is configured correctly.
